system.longDesc:
Requirement: Empathy (Novice)

Cost: 1–3 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 10

Test: None

Your touch takes away pain and restores health. You can choose to spend up to 3 PP when you use empathic healing. use this power on yourself. You may also spend 1PP to remove any penalties caused by pain or discomfort, but not physical limitations such as blindness. You may do this instead of restoring Health, or in addition to it, adding the 1 PP cost to the healing cost.
